plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for AKCP sensorProbe / securityProbe environment monitors (SPAGENT-MIB, enterprise PEN 3854). It reports uptime, temperature and relative humidity sensor readings, sensor status, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Reading of each online AKCP temperature sensor in degrees Celsius, from sensorProbeTempDegree (SPAGENT-MIB, 1.3.6.1.4.1.3854.1.2.2.1.16.1.3). The higher-resolution sensorProbeTempDegreeRaw (1.3.6.1.4.1.3854.1.2.2.1.16.1.14, divided by 10) is used when it agrees with the integer reading, and Fahrenheit readings (sensorProbeTempDegreeType 1.3.6.1.4.1.3854.1.2.2.1.16.1.12) are converted. Offline sensors are skipped.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Reading of each online AKCP humidity sensor in percent, from sensorProbeHumidityPercent (1.3.6.1.4.1.3854.1.2.2.1.17.1.3). Offline sensors and values outside 0-100 are skipped.

metrics.name: env_temperature_state
metrics.description: Status of each temperature sensor from sensorProbeTempStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.3854.1.2.2.1.16.1.4): normal maps to 1; high / low warning, high / low critical and sensorError map to 2. noStatus produces no value.

metrics.name: env_humidity_state
metrics.description: Status of each humidity sensor from sensorProbeHumidityStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.3854.1.2.2.1.17.1.4): normal maps to 1; high / low warning, high / low critical and sensorError map to 2. noStatus produces no value.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
